custom_json.article.CardItem: Choose VideoCard by aid, LiveCard by room_id, ArticleCard by id; preserve incompatible or unknown objects in raw.
custom_json.bangumi.Stat: Use coin/play aliases only when coins/views are absent.
custom_json.dynamic.Feed: Decode update_num as quoted or numeric uint64; null and missing are zero.
custom_json.dynamic.DetailItem: Convert numeric id_str to exact text and null/missing tombstones to empty text; recurse into orig.
custom_json.dynamic.NavAuthor: Decode mid as quoted or numeric uint64.
custom_json.dynamic.NavItem: Decode rid as quoted or numeric uint64.
custom_json.dynamic.NavFeed: Decode update_num as quoted or numeric uint64.
custom_json.dynamic.MyInfo: Decode dyns/following/mid as quoted or numeric int64.
custom_json.live.LotteryInfo: Retain undocumented top-level lottery sections in extra.
custom_json.login.Nav: Convert guest zero mid and blank uname/face to null; validate nonzero member IDs.
custom_json.message.Sessions: Require non-null page flags; missing or null session_list remains null.
custom_json.message.Session: Require session identity, timestamps, counters and flags; last_msg may be missing or null.
custom_json.message.SessionMessages: Require non-null page flags and sequence boundaries; missing or null messages remains null.
custom_json.message.PrivateMessage: Require message identity, content, sequence, timestamp, status, source and notify_code; preserve unknown message kinds.
custom_json.user.CardSummary: Accept either quoted or numeric member IDs with full uint64 validation.
custom_json.user.SpaceNotice: Wrap the API string payload as content.
custom_json.user.NameToUIDItem: Accept either quoted or numeric uid with full uint64 validation.
custom_json.user.flexibleMID: Shared quoted/numeric MID decoder used by CardSummary and NameToUIDItem.
custom_json.video.DASHDolby: Use zero for nonnumeric or invalid uint8 Dolby type markers.
custom_json.video.DASHStream: Read base_url/backup_url/mime_type/frame_rate aliases when camelCase values are empty or null.
custom_json.video.CollectionPage: Read page_num/page_size with fallback to num/size.
custom_json.webwidget.HeaderData: Parse nonblank split_layer JSON into parsedSplitLayer using the lossless decoder.
